23305884: EBV infection leads to prolonged changes in host gene expression during B-cell transformation.

23326722: The clinical and pathological features of adult T-cell leukaemia/lymphoma in Afro-Caribbean patients from Barbados are comparable to those in other Caribbean islands and Japan.

23331269: Acoustic landmarks in speech facilitate delta-theta oscillations that enhance speech comprehension by aligning with critical-band temporal envelopes.

23342686: X-ray crystallography provides crucial insights into the binding sites of A-site inhibitors in the small ribosomal subunit.

23349986: Dexamethasone reduces the risk of postoperative nausea and vomiting in children after tonsillectomy compared to placebo.

23351136: Taste receptor T1r3 is not essential for detecting sweet and umami tastes in mice.

23377475: Acute kidney injury significantly increases the risk of chronic kidney disease development.

23389795: The identification of common genetic variants significantly contributes to our understanding of chronic disease susceptibility.

23393712: Rho small GTPases play a crucial role in regulating cell-cell adhesion through signaling pathways.

23397658: FGF21 plays a crucial role in regulating glucose and lipid metabolism through multiple tissue-specific actions.

23400191: The prevalence of intracranial aneurysms in adults with coarctation of the aorta is significantly higher than in the general population.

23403754: ATP and mitochondrial hyperpolarization are necessary for specific stages of both apoptosis and necrosis.

23418635: Wnt proteins are necessary for the self-renewal of embryonic stem cells and prevent their differentiation into epiblast stem cells.

23420807: PD166285 and PD173074 inhibit receptor tyrosine kinases involved in angiogenesis.

23423230: The VirB type IV secretion system is crucial for Bartonella henselae's pathogenicity in human endothelial cells.

23439808: Serum cystatin C correlates with arterial stiffness as measured by pulse wave velocity in males and females, even in those with normal serum creatinine levels.

23471400: Circulating miR-16 and miR-199a can effectively differentiate hepatocellular carcinoma from chronic liver diseases based on serum levels.

23495058: Mitochondrial haplogroup N9a is associated with a reduced risk of schizophrenia in the Chinese Han population.

23509113: Acute inflammation in the lung plays a critical role in both health and disease.

23513718: Soluble guanylate cyclase plays a role in the dilator responses of cerebral microcirculation to nitric oxide.

23513818: Noxa regulates Mcl-1 degradation by modulating the interaction between Mcl-1 and USP9X.

23531592: By 2000, six million pregnant women and five to ten million children will be infected with HIV-1.

23557241: There is a statistically significant association between increased birthweight and the risk of developing breast cancer.

23573229: H. hepaticus does not induce colitis in IL-10-deficient mice.

23594156: There are spatial clusters of Barmah Forest virus disease in Queensland, Australia.

23599024: SP-B regulates radioresistance in NSCLC by modulating TGF-β signaling.

23601616: Liraglutide improves synaptic plasticity in ob/ob mice by increasing Mash1 expression.

23604601: Post-transcriptional regulation plays a crucial role in determining the initiation of meiosis in Saccharomyces cerevisiae.

23618826: The workflow combining genetic trapping, affinity-capture, and SRM-MS effectively captures the dynamic proteome of pre-60S particles post-nuclear export.

23634484: Cdk1 phosphorylation of HuR at S202 promotes nuclear retention of HuR.

23639838: Surgical resection is more effective than whole brain radiation for treating brain metastases.

23649163: Peristomal pyoderma gangrenosum is more commonly associated with inflammatory bowel disease than with other conditions.

23664875: Tof1p-Csm3p protein complex plays a crucial role in protecting replication forks at rDNA termini from Rrm3p helicase activity.

23665162: Hypomethylation of LINE-1 repetitive elements in blood leukocytes is associated with an increased risk of hepatocellular carcinoma.

23670644: The ketogenic diet is effective in reducing seizure frequency in children with drug-resistant epilepsy.

23704559: The prevalence of intracranial aneurysms in children treated for coarctation of the aorta at an early age is low.

23716150: Transcriptional profiling of heart chambers reveals distinct gene expression patterns crucial for cardiac development and function.

23746332: Fast calcium imaging can directly record single action potentials in enteric neurones.

23777820: A murine cell line derived from spontaneous myeloma in C57 BL/KaLwRij mice can induce osteolytic bone lesions similar to human myeloma bone disease.

23783727: Ticagrelor reduces the risk of cardiovascular events in diabetic patients with acute coronary syndromes compared to clopidogrel.

23830488: Circadian gene expression correlates with liver metastasis in colorectal cancer patients.

23841828: The Danish prescription registries cover a substantial portion of the Danish population.

23851261: Uncertainty in the first stage of integrative structural modeling primarily arises from sparse, noisy, ambiguous data or data derived from heterogeneous samples.

23862975: Moist occlusive dressing with Aquacel(®) Ag is more effective than moist open dressing with MEBO(®) in reducing infection rates in partial-thickness facial burns.

23865182: Amitriptylinoxide is as effective as amitriptyline in treating chronic tension-type headache.

23869951: Genetic ablation of LHA glutamatergic neurons leads to increased caloric intake and weight gain in mice consuming a high-fat diet.

23887844: Glucose metabolism reduces cytochrome c activity to inhibit apoptosis in neurons and cancer cells.

23895668: mTORC2 plays a crucial role in regulating amino acid metabolism in cancer through the phosphorylation of the cystine-glutamate antiporter xCT.

23908217: The prevalence of osteitis fibrosa in pediatric patients undergoing dialysis is significantly higher than in the general population.

23912923: VISTA gene disruption leads to a proinflammatory phenotype in mice.

23913146: The Loqs-PD isoform of Loquacious protein specifically interacts with Dicer2 in the esiRNA biogenesis pathway.

23929297: Ghrelin secretion is stimulated by β1-adrenergic receptors in ghrelinoma cells and fasting mice.

23932173: Dominance relationships between S-alleles in Brassica campestris vary between stigma and pollen.

23934390: MicroRNA-203 acts as a tumor suppressor in non-small cell lung cancer by targeting Bmi1.

23938319: Retinoic acid receptor/RXR heterodimers maintain similar coactivator interaction capabilities regardless of ligand binding.

23967973: The distribution of body fat, as measured by waist circumference and waist-to-hip ratio, is more strongly associated with the risk of death than body-mass index in European populations.

23972114: Phosphorylation of optineurin enhances the autophagic clearance of Salmonella.

23974474: PKD1 phosphorylates AMPKα2 at Serine 491, impairing its activity in skeletal muscle cells.

23983289: ICD-9-CM codes have high specificity but low sensitivity in identifying cardiovascular and stroke risk factors among Medicare beneficiaries.

24003461: Calcific aortic valve disease results from calcification of valvular endothelial cells.
